name: The Hateful Memes Challenge Dataset
description: The Hateful Memes Challenge dataset is a multimodal dataset created by Meta AI to benchmark hate-speech detection in memes. Containing 10,000 newly created memes combining images and text, it introduces 'multimodal confounders'—subtle paired examples where neither the image nor the text alone is hateful, but their combination creates a hateful message, making unimodal models fail and necessitating deep vision-and-language reasoning.
